name: TrackLens × Ultraplan Integration
description: Integrate Ultraplan's browser-based review capabilities into Maestro's TrackLens system — server infrastructure enhancements, CodeMirror inline editing, workflow integration across all Maestro commands, keyword auto-triggering, agent-side feedback loop, and annotation serialization bug fix.

bugs.title: Approve/Deny fails when annotations present — double-stringified JSON
bugs.rootCause: body.annotations = JSON.stringify(annotations) double-encodes the array. Server expects Vec<Annotation> but receives a JSON string, causing 422 Unprocessable Entity.
bugs.fix: Remove JSON.stringify, send annotations as array directly. Update TypeScript type from string to Annotation[].
